settings.subheading: Two masterpieces born from rare ingredients and a century of olfactory tradition. Each bottle holds a story that lingers long after you leave the room.

settings.name: Nuit Éternelle
settings.description: A nocturnal masterpiece built on the darkest, richest oud from the forests of Laos, softened by Bulgarian rose and warm ambergris. Made for those who leave a lasting impression.

settings.name: Aube Dorée
settings.description: A golden sunrise captured in fragrance — vibrant bergamot opens to reveal jasmine absolute and a heart of warm vetiver, anchored by a silken musk base.

settings.text: This is not just a fragrance — it is a memory. Nuit Éternelle takes me back to moonlit evenings in Marrakech. I have been wearing it every day for six months and people stop me on the street.

settings.text: I have worn fragrance my entire life, but nothing has drawn compliments quite like Aube Dorée. The sillage is extraordinary. Three people asked me what I was wearing in a single afternoon.
